title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 10
body: Final check. Does he do what he says? Does he apologise without a speech? Does he make time, or make excuses? Is he nice to the waiter? Does he mind you having friends? If you hesitate on more than two, you already know the answer. You do not need another reel. You need to stop explaining him.
caption:
Save this before your next situationship.

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 10
body: Final check. Does she respect your time? Does she talk about you kindly when you are not there? Does she apologise without a three day silence? Does she make you smaller in front of her friends? If it feels like constant exams, you are not in love. You are in a very long viva.
caption:
Which one is you? Be honest.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 10
body: Final check. Do they talk about you or about themselves? Does he ask you one real question? Is anyone curious what you actually want? If the only thing you were asked was the recipe for biryani, you have your answer. You are allowed to say no. Even after the samosas.
caption:
Save this for the next aunty visit.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 10
body: Exit plan. Unmute your life. Reply slower. Plan a weekend without checking your phone. If she wants you, she will fix the maybe. If not, you saved a year and a lot of mobile data. A clear yes should never need a translator. Walk out. The door was always open.
caption:
Send this to someone who needs a clear no.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 10
body: Final check after the date. Did he listen? Did he ask one real question? Was he kind to the waiter? Did you laugh once? If you needed two glasses of water to survive it, do not book the second one. A good first date feels short. A bad one feels like a rishta meeting.
caption:
Tag your date's group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 10
body: Final check. Does he reply with effort? Does he call when it matters? Does he make plans, not just promises? You should not need to decode a text for an hour. If your friends need to read his message twice to explain it, the message is the answer. Put the phone down.
caption:
Send this to the one who reads and does not reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 10
body: Final check. A good friend gets a "sure." A support contact gets an "I have limits." You can care for someone without being their night shift. Your energy is not free. Charge at least a samosa. And if she gets upset, that is your answer too.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs to stop being the helpline.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 10
body: Final check. Is he the same person with you and without you? Does he introduce you? Does he stay when the fun ends? Players are great at beginnings and terrible at Tuesdays. Look for the man who is boring on a Tuesday and still shows up. He is rarer and much better.
caption:
Screenshot this for your next situationship.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 10
body: Final check. Is he consistent online and offline? Does he show you the same version of himself? Does his profile make you feel secure or anxious? If you check his Instagram more than he checks on you, the problem is not the algorithm. Close the app. Drink some water.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs an Instagram audit.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 10
body: Your light is coming too. Maybe he is not the one. But one day somebody will get in and say "let's go" and not ask for a discount. Until then, stop chasing the ones with the light off. Wait for the one who stops. He will not make you run after him.
caption:
Tag the friend waiting for him to be ready.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 10
body: Final verdict. The committee is not evil, it is scared. Be clear about what you want, say it once, say it calmly. Then ask for the biryani. The meeting will go long anyway. In the end it is your marriage, not their agenda. And if they cannot decide, you will.
caption:
Tag the friend whose uncle has opinions.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 10
body: Final check. A real spiritual partner does the boring things. They show up on time. They say sorry. They call back. They do not announce their healing. A deep person does not tell you he is deep. He listens and pays the bill. Keep the sage. Check the behaviour.
caption:
Tag the friend who dated a life coach.

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 10
body: How to read between the lines. Ignore the adjectives, look for the verbs. What does he do? What does she do? What do they actually enjoy? A profile with no hobby is a resume with no human. Meet them, ask for their weirdest habit and see if you laugh. That is the real filter.
